'''Cmaoli Di''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]]. Between [[3701 BBY]] and [[3699 BBY]], the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] was charted through the planet as part of the [[Seswenna Expansion]].<ref name="TEA" /> Cmaoli Di was known to receive broadcasts from the [[Brema News]] service.
